title: On the maximum density of a matrix and a transcendental Turán-type density
summary: We prove that the inducibility of $P_4$ in ordered monotone balanced bipartite graphs is $2/e^2$, establishing the smallest known graph with transcendental Turán-type density. Moreover, the limit object is a binary graphon, so it generates a deterministic model. This is a special case of a more general framework addressed here -- the asymptotic maximum density of a constant matrix over an arbitrary symbol set, in a large, possibly monotone, matrix.
